name: atproto-comments-plugin
description: WordPress plugin that shows AT Protocol replies as post comments.

scripts.build: npm run vendor && wp-scripts build editor=./src/editor/index.js settings=./src/settings/index.js --output-path=build
scripts.test:php:multisite: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/atproto-comments env WP_TESTS_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.make-pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/atproto-comments wp i18n make-pot . languages/atproto-comments.pot --slug=atproto-comments --domain=atproto-comments --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,assets/vendor,src,scripts
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check atproto-comments --exclude-directories=.git,node_modules,vendor,tests,scripts,openspec,.claude,.github,dist --exclude-files=composer.json,composer.lock,package.json,package-lock.json,phpcs.xml.dist,phpunit.xml.dist,.wp-env.json,.wp-env.override.json,eslint.config.cjs,.gitignore,.nvmrc,README.md,.DS_Store,.phpunit.result.cache
